notes.title: Patch Notes 8/27/24
notes.content:
A list of patch notes for the most recent build of Roswell Ranch:

- Removed a ladder in the Hay Mayz that was causing players to get stuck.
- Fixed a bug in which the UFO could abduct players through the roof of the shed.
- Removed all cutscenes from any "restarts" after the player dies (i.e. cutscenes can ONLY be triggered by clicking the Play button on the main menu).
- Decreased the max walk speed of the aliens by 20%.

If you find any more bugs or issues with Roswell Ranch, please make me aware at austinthomasvfx@gmail.com
